title: Intelligent thresholded committer for Optimize suggestions
creator: Marco Ruiz
description: Build an autonomous committer component that can safely auto-apply Optimize recommendations (batching and KV-cache profiles) using a multi-signal gating architecture. The committer evaluates a 'confidence ladder' that combines offline replay sims, runtime shadow traffic, cost delta envelopes, quality regressions on targeted prompt sets, and operational liveness checks before committing changes. Unlike existing staged controllers, this feature focuses on narrow, low-risk profile shifts (e.g., safe batch size increases, cache prefix prefetch toggles) with an ability to auto-rollback on validated regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Commits only occur when all configured gates pass: replay-sim, shadow-canary, QPS stability, latency SLO delta, and cost delta within envelope
Automated rollback triggers within 5 minutes of observable quality regression or latency SLO breach >2x of threshold
Operator can opt into: autopilot-mode, manual-approve-mode, or pilot-cohort-mode per customer namespace
Audit records for every decision emitted to the console and append-only log for at least 90 days
E2E test harness that replays historical tracing data and asserts no false-positive commits across 3 representative customer traces
implementation_notes: Add a new component runtime/committer with a pluggable gate interface
Gates to implement: ReplaySimulator (offline), ShadowCanary (runtime shadowing), DeltaEnvelope (cost), EvalRunner (prompt set quality), StabilityWatch (latency/error monitors)
Decisions must include deterministic seeds and observation snapshots to make replays reproducible
Expose JSON policy schema for customers to opt-out or constrain autopilot on a per-route basis
rollout_plan: Start internal rollout: 1) Sandbox mode in staging with customer-telemetry replay for 48 hours; 2) Pilot cohort for 5 low-risk customers with explicit opt-in; 3) Gradual expansion by doubling pilot size weekly if no regressions. Enable a single-operator kill-switch in Console and an automatic pause on first detected regression in any pilot tenant.
testing_plan: Unit tests for gate combinator logic, integration tests with simulated runtime kernel selection, offline replay tests using 3 archived workloads, canary shadow traffic tests with synthetic load and golden prompt sets. Add chaos tests for partial telemetry loss and delayed metrics.
monitoring_playbook: Create dashboards: Commit rate, Gate pass/fail distribution, Time-to-commit, Rollback count, Per-tenant latency delta, Prompt-set quality regression chart. Alerts: SLO breach -> page; any rollback -> ops-channel and incident ticket auto-created. Postmortem template linked in docs.
rollback_procedure: Automated rollback: revert config in runtime and trigger a read-only sweeping validation for five minutes; operator notification and auto-open incident; if rollback fails or repeated, escalate to manual freeze of autopilot for tenant and trigger on-call runbook. Record revert PR and link to audit log.
risk_assessment: Medium. Main risks: false negatives in quality eval leading to bad commits, telemetry gaps causing delayed rollbacks, and customer churn from visible latency regressions. Mitigations: conservative default thresholds, required operator-acknowledgement for cross-model quantization changes, and shadowing for minimum 24h before commit on high-variance tenants.
